JQHTML Component Class.description: JQHTML component class with the common lifecycle hooks

on_create() Hook.description: Runs once when the component instance is created, before the first render

on_load() Hook.description: Fetch asynchronous data. Only this.args and this.data are available here

on_loaded() Hook.description: Process data after on_load() resolves, before the re-render (was after_load())

on_render() Hook.description: Runs after every render, once the component DOM exists

on_ready() Hook.description: Runs once this component and all of its children are ready

on_stop() Hook.description: Tear down timers, listeners and other resources when the component stops

on_viewport_resize() Hook.description: Synchronous layout hook: after on_render()/on_ready() and on debounced window resize

gate_load().description: Delay the first on_load() until the promise settles. Register gates in on_create()

One-Shot Event Listener.description: Subscribe to a component event once, then deregister

Load-Only Lifecycle Flag.description: Truncate the lifecycle to on_create() + on_load(): no render, children, on_render, on_loaded or on_ready

Load-Render-Only Lifecycle Flag.description: on_create + render + on_load + re-render, skipping on_render, on_loaded and on_ready

Force Initial Render Flag.description: Force the initial render even when the component boots detached
